records.name: Harbor Fellowship
records.description: Shipowners and maritime interests concerned with berth access, harbor operations, and commercial predictability.

records.name: Warehouse Guild
records.description: Recognized warehouse operators and factors concerned with secure cargo, records, fire prevention, and access.

records.name: Market Guild
records.description: Established market members and merchants concerned with stalls, commercial access, and trade privileges.

records.name: River Carters' and Bargemen's Company
records.description: River operators seeking fair tolls, safe landings, and recognition for inland transport.

records.name: Shipwrights' Brotherhood
records.description: Skilled shipwright organization protecting apprentices, craft standards, labor, and timber supply.

records.name: Ratfolk Underways Community
records.description: Decentralized ratfolk community beneath Tallowmere with families, workshops, routes, and limited coordination. It is not a unified criminal faction or single political bloc.

records.name: The Grey Net
records.description: Loose arrangement of handlers, carters, lookouts, and buyers involved in cargo diversion, dockside theft, false handling claims, and resale.

records.name: The Bent Seal
records.description: Loose fraud network dealing in forged cargo marks, altered receipts, false ownership papers, and commercial fraud.

records.name: The Quiet Account
records.description: Informal network arranging private lending, debt collection, coercion, and settlements.

records.name: Artificers' Hall
records.description: Recognized masters in metalwork, carpentry, leatherwork, pottery, textiles, and related crafts.
